cls: Could you add a line: `Fixed: 40863985` before the `Change-Id:` since this fixes https://issues.chromium.org/40863985 .
Instead of making this change at 2 of the 4 callers of `HandleKeyboardActivation`, I think you should put it inside of `HandleKeyboardActivation`, since I think it should apply for all callers.
For making behavior changes that have any risk of web compatibility, our practice is to put them behind a `RuntimeEnabledFeatures` flag. You should do that here. See https://crrev.com/c/8607746 for…
You should run `git cl format` to fix the formatting here. The spacing, bracing, and indentation are all incorrect, but `git cl format` should fix all of it for you.
Maybe a brief comment here would be good, such as: ``` // If the focus is on a descendant (such as a text field), skip handling keyboard activation. ``` (But line wrap at 78 characters or so.)
add a comment saying what this flag does and which milestone it was set to stable in?
